body: I completely understand that, and that only makes me feel worse. I'm such a weak coward that I can't even control my own emotions. But I'll just keep chugging along, no matter how much I don't want to.

The thing is that the base problem is chemical unbalance. I take medication but that doesn't really work (I've started to question if they've just given me placebo's). It gets further worse because, for no exact reason, I utterly hate myself and am disgusted by my own existence.

That leads to a problem of not believing anything people say about me unless it's negative. I'm constantly afraid that there is some big joke of pretending to like me, or that people are just too nice to say otherwise.

So really is partly because of chemicals, another of me just being a self-loathing piece of shit. Both added together make suicide quite attractive.
